display.purpose: Net Savings figure on the dashboard only.

figure.purpose: Any currency amount or percentage, always tabular-nums, always JetBrains Mono.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-headings for sections, form fields, and dropdown groups.

shadows.name: overlay

motion.name: count-up

motion.name: slide-to-apply-fill

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent-filled action button used for primary submits and creation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1f6f52; color: #fffefc; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f6f52; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Tinted (not solid) red action for delete/destructive confirmations.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: rgba(179,64,43,0.1); color: #b3402b; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(179,64,43,0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b3402b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Recessed text field used across all forms (income, goals, contributions).
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-amount">Amount (€)</label><input id="ds-amount" class="ds-input" type="number" placeholder="e.g. 2500.00" />
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#948d7c; margin-bottom:6px; } .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; padding:12px 16px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color:#17140f; background:#f0ecE4; border:1px solid #e1dcd1; border-radius:8px; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #1f6f52; border-color:#1f6f52; }

components.name: Sealed Badge
components.description: Rotated ink-stamp completion motif for finished goals / applied recurring items.
components.html: Completed
components.css: .ds-sealed { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-sealed-ring { position:relative; width:20px; height:20px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:9999px; border:1.5px solid #1f6f52; color:#1f6f52; transform: rotate(-10deg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px currentColor; } .ds-sealed-label { font-family:'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; color:#1f6f52; transform: rotate(-2deg); }

components.name: Slide To Apply
components.description: Pill-shaped slide-to-confirm gesture control for the monthly recurring-expense apply ritual; also a real clickable button.
components.html: Apply 3 expenses
components.css: .ds-slide-track { position:relative; width:100%; height:56px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid #e1dcd1; background:#f0ecE4; overflow:hidden; } .ds-slide-fill { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; transform-origin:left; transform:scaleX(0.15); background:rgba(31,111,82,0.25); transition: transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-slide-label { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; color:#17140f; pointer-events:none; } .ds-slide-handle { position:absolute; top:6px; left:6px; width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:9999px; border:none; background:#1f6f52; color:#fffefc; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:grab; } .ds-slide-handle:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f6f52; outline-offset:2px; }

components.description: Draggable/swipeable month navigator with always-available chevron fallback.

narrative.overview: Vaulty reads each month like one page of the user's own printed financial ledger or bank statement, not a row of side-by-side app-menu cards. The ground is a warm-cool drifting off-white in light mode and a warm near-black in dark mode — deliberately never flat white or pure black, so the surface always reads as paper or stock rather than a screen default. One restrained deep-emerald accent carries positive figures and all primary actions; a muted brick-red carries negative figures and destructive actions; a violet is reserved for goal-related figures. Hairline rules divide every section the way a printed statement divides its line items. Rendering is flat throughout: no gradients, no drop shadows for elevation, no neon glow — a direct rejection of the prior dark-only, neon-adjacent look the product brief explicitly ruled out. Public Sans carries all UI, body, and display text — one quiet grotesk for everything. JetBrains Mono is reserved specifically for currency figures and date/category micro-labels, echoing a ledger column's monospace alignment; every mono figure carries tabular numerals so amounts align vertically as they change.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white / warm near-black grounds, never pure white or pure black.
One accent (emerald) for positive/primary, one for negative (brick-red), one for goals (violet) — no other saturated color enters the UI except the eight user-chosen savings-goal swatches.
Hairline dividers instead of card shadows to separate sections.
Public Sans for everything textual; JetBrains Mono strictly for figures and micro-labels, always tabular.
Flat, no-gradient rendering; the only "elevation" is a modal/dialog drop shadow.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Sections and list rows are separated by a 1px hairline (--hairline), never a card shadow. The only shadow in the system (shadow-lg) is reserved for floating overlays (Modal, ConfirmDialog, settings dropdown) that must visually detach from the page.

rules.name: The One Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: --bg, --surface, and --surface-sunken are always warm-tinted, never pure white/black/gray. This is a direct, evidenced rejection of a neon-on-pure-black look.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: font-mono (JetBrains Mono) is applied only to currency figures, dates, month keys, and short uppercase micro-labels — never to headings, body copy, or paragraph text. If it isn't a ledger figure or column label, it isn't mono.

rules.name: The Tabular-Nums-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Any element carrying font-mono also carries tabular-nums, so digits never shift width as counted-up figures animate or as list values update.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest never carry a shadow. A shadow appears only when an element floats above the document (modal, dialog, dropdown), never as generic card styling.

dos: Do keep every monetary figure in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, regardless of which page it appears on.
Do use hairline dividers (border-hairline, divide-hairline) to separate sections and list rows instead of card shadows or extra background changes.
Do reserve shadow-lg for floating overlays only (Modal, ConfirmDialog, dropdown menus).
Do make every signature gesture (month-scrub drag, slide-to-apply) additive to a plain click/keyboard path — never the only way to complete the action.
Do keep destructive actions in the tinted bg-negative/10 text-negative treatment, not a solid red fill.
donts: Don't introduce a gradient or a drop-shadow-as-elevation anywhere; the system is flat by design (a direct rejection of the prior neon/dark-only look the product brief ruled out).
Don't use pure white, pure black, or a cool/neutral gray for bg/surface/surface-sunken — the warm drift is load-bearing to the "printed page" identity.
Don't apply JetBrains Mono to headings, paragraphs, or navigation labels — it is reserved for figures, dates, and uppercase micro-labels only.

Don't rebuild the Modal/ConfirmDialog forms as inline in-place editing. This was explicitly proposed and explicitly declined by the user during this build (restyle-only, keep as modals) — treat it as a binding decision, not an unresolved gap.

Don't treat the SealedBadge ink-stamp or the Goal Illustration postcard band as general-purpose decorative devices for future surfaces; both are reserved for the specific states/surface documented above.
